text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—And already we're at the fourth corner!!
Marvelous Sunday is looking in prime condition, is she going to pull ahead?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —Yaaaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Let's do this, Marvelous...!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (An "omen"—?!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ――No, you're wrong!!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—It's Bubble Gum Fellow!!
Bubble Gum Fellow takes it!!
ââ*Clap, clap. Clap, clap.*

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(This must be a lingering subconscious fear...!
The fear of exceeding my limits! But——)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—Right now!!
There are no limits for me!!!

Clap! Clap! Clap! Clap!
Clapclapclapclapclapclap
Clapclapclapclapclap――!!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(This body has already left its limits behind!!
A fleeting "omen" like that?!
I'll blow it away!! As many times as it takes!!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I'm the one who'll make our dreams swell to the max!!!!!!
(SKREEEEEEEECH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Bubble!! Bubble charges in!!
It's Bubble Gum Fellow!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Bubble Gum Fellow crosses the finish line!!!!!
(WOOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa, haa――

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I did it……――

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Alright...!!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelous—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Amazing...
You were truly incredible, Bubble...!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I felt it...!!
The potential of the bubbles exploded into something truly, utterly Marvelous...!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's why I know I can—
become even more Marvelous!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Everyoooooooooone!!!!

text_block_list.name: The Four Heavenly Kings
text_block_list.text:
"Bubble...!!"
"Bubble!!"
"Bubble-chan!!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I wooooon!!!!!

Bubble Gum Fellow comes diving in,
and the rest of the Big Four and I catch her.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Bubble...!!
Seriously... congratulations...!!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
Without a doubt...
that was a run worthy of being etched into history...!

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Waaaahhh!!!
You were so cuuuuute and cooooolーーー!!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...!!
It's the ultimate victory we seized together...!!

Through blurred vision, the only sight shining
brighter and clearer than anything was Bubble Gum Fellow
celebrating with his closest friends—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
“—Now then, let's hear from Bubble Gum Fellow,
who achieved a brilliant victory
in the 'Takarazuka Kinen'!”

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
To cut to the chase,
what was the secret behind your victory today?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"...In today's race, I never could have
claimed victory on my own."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: With Trainer, who always supports me by my side and gives me courage with strong, reassuring words—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I believe this victory was only possible through striving together and sharpening each other with my dear friends here... the members of the 'Four Heavenly Kings'.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That is why today's victory
does not belong to me alone.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: "Please remember this: I won today precisely because I am one of the 'Four Heavenly Kings'!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
And!!
Here and now, I make this declaration!!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
The upcoming Tenno Sho (Autumn)!!
There, I shall achieve the first back-to-back victory in history!!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"With that, once again—
we'll whip up a 'Four Heavenly Kings' whirlwind!!"
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer.
Was this your plan right from the beginning?"

I hadn't been told in advance that
Bubble Gum Fellow would announce her entry
into the Tenno Sho (Autumn) right here.
However—
choice_data_list: ...I was thinking the exact same thing.

text_block_list.text:
The next future Bubble Gum Fellow aims for.
The world she wants to carve open.
I know it all too well, even without words.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: ...I might just get... a little jealous...

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Man, Bubble was seriously incredible today!
She's gotten even stronger since last year, it totally blew me away...!"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
This isn't just a comeback, it's straight-up evolution at this point!
Man, I'm getting insanely hyped for this year's Tenno Sho (Autumn)!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —You have my thanks, Bubble.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Your running inspires dreams and carves open possibilities...
Without a doubt, you're the strongest right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why—
I must surpass you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
To show the "ideal" to all Umamusume—
as one who demonstrates the supreme realm of possibility...!!

A new dream begins to swell.
And with it, a new fire ignites.

"The stage where everything converges passes beyond the summer sky...
leading into the second 'Tenno Sho (Autumn).'"
